regions.name: Cayo
regions.title: Cayo District
text: Cayo is a district located in the west part of Belize, and it contains the capital, Belmopan. It is the most extensive, second-most populous and third-most densely populated of the six districts of Belize. The district's capital is the town of San Ignacio.

regions.name: Orange Walk
regions.title: Orange Walk District
text: Orange Walk is a district in the northwest of the nation of Belize, with its district capital in Orange Walk Town.

regions.name: Corozal
regions.title: Corozal District
text: Corozal is the northernmost district of the nation of Belize. The population was 46,071 in 2024. The district capital is Corozal Town.
Pre-Columbian Maya ruins are found in Corozal at Santa Rita near Corozal Town, and at Cerros.

regions.name: Toledo
regions.title: Toledo District
text: Toledo is the southernmost and least populated district in Belize. Punta Gorda is the District capital. According to the Human Development Index (HDI), it is the second most developed region in the country. The district has a diverse topography which features rainforests, extensive cave networks, coastal lowland plains, and offshore cays. Toledo is home to a wide range of cultures such as Mopan, Kekchi Maya, Creole, Garifuna, East Indians, Mennonites, Mestizos, and descendants of US Confederate settlers.

regions.name: Stann Creek
regions.title: Stann Creek District
text: Stann Creek is a district in the south east region of Belize. According to the 2022 census, the district had a population of 48,162 people. Its capital is the town of Dangriga, formerly known as "Stann Creek Town". Stann comes from "stanns", or safe havens used by colonialists coming from the "old world" to the "new world".

regions.name: Belize
regions.title: Belize District
text: Belize is a district of the nation of Belize. Its capital is Belize City.
